title: Fourier Level One Bound for Condorcet Probability
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $f$ map the $n$-dimensional sign cube to a sign. The probability that a uniformly random ranking profile of $n$ voters produces a societal Condorcet winner is at most $\frac79+\frac29\sum_{i=1}^n \widehat{f}(\{i\})^2$, where $\widehat{f}(\{i\})$ is the singleton Fourier coefficient of the real-valued version of $f$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ maps the $n$-dimensional sign cube to a sign
